root_cause.text: In the md/raid10 subsystem, when a NOWAIT request fails in `regular_request_wait` due to a raised barrier, calling `raid_end_bio_io` unconditionally decrements `conf->nr_pending` via `allow_barrier` even though the NOWAIT request never incremented it, causing `nr_pending` to underflow and deadlocking the resync thread.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description states that "NOWAIT requests... do not increment nr_pending in wait_barrier()" but "raid_end_bio_io() eventually calls allow_barrier() and it will unconditionally do an atomic_dec_and_test(&conf->nr_pending)". The patch diff resolves this by replacing `raid_end_bio_io(r10_bio)` with `free_r10bio(r10_bio)` when `regular_request_wait` fails in both `raid10_read_request` and `raid10_write_request`.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix incorrect I/O completion handling in RAID10 read request failure path by directly freeing the r10_bio structure.
intent_record.what: Replaced the function call raid_end_bio_io(r10_bio) with free_r10bio(r10_bio) in the failure path of regular_request_wait within raid10_read_request.
intent_record.how: This change avoids incorrectly ending the bio I/O session when a regular request wait fails, instead directly freeing the allocated r10_bio structure to prevent resource leaks or double-completion errors.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix incorrect resource cleanup in raid10_write_request by directly freeing the r10_bio structure when waiting for a regular request fails.
intent_record.what: Replaced the function call raid_end_bio_io(r10_bio) with free_r10bio(r10_bio) in the failure path of regular_request_wait within raid10_write_request.
intent_record.how: This change directly deallocates the r10_bio structure instead of attempting to end I/O processing on it, preventing potential null pointer dereferences or incorrect bio completion handling when a request wait fails.

relevance_review.reason: The group directly addresses the incorrect I/O completion handling in the RAID10 failure path, which is the root cause of the nr_pending underflow and deadlock when a NOWAIT request fails.

The group directly addresses the vulnerability by freeing the r10_bio structure directly when a regular request wait fails, avoiding the incorrect call to raid_end_bio_io which would erroneously decrement nr_pending and cause an underflow.
